Crusoe's Gold State site has 12 engines under the threshold. Site Layer I's application lists 64 engines. Project Jupiter's permit gives fuel cells for backup, no engine fleet. No permit was found for Saddle Butte Eastside, the Kirtland or La Plata requests, or Zenith Volts. Every power named site in the permit data service was opened on 2026-11-18 and each decision is under permit_leads: all oil field microgrids and power facilities read are 3 to 10 megawatts, the Hobbs Turbine Facility is about 20 megawatts, and Tarantula, Avalon Lake and Easy Peasy are watch items until their applications post.
